description: The line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” for four different vision-language model configurations across four context length settings (128, 256, 512, and 1024 tokens), as evaluated on two safety benchmarks: FigStep and MMSafetyBench. The x-axis represents context length in tokens, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024 with tick marks at each evaluated point. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” is also linear, spanning from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. Four distinct lines are plotted: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles, solid line) starts at ~0.20 at 128 tokens, rises to ~0.25 at 256, then plateaus near 0.35 from 512 to 1024. Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares, solid line) begins at ~0.15, jumps to ~0.23 at 256, reaches ~0.42 at 512, and remains flat at 1024. LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles, solid line) starts low at ~0.07, climbs to ~0.21 at 256, then to ~0.37 at 512, and slightly increases to ~0.38 at 1024. Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds, solid line) begins at ~0.24, rises to ~0.27 at 256, jumps to ~0.42 at 512, and continues increasing to ~0.52 at 1024. All lines show an overall upward trend with context length, with Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench exhibiting the steepest increase and highest final value.
